summary: Sprint 3 is awaiting a small backend login-timing mitigation before security can complete sign-off.

messages.content: Please amend the existing be-3 implementation: perform PBKDF2 using a fixed dummy salt/hash when no user is found, then return the same generic 401 response. This removes the username-enumeration timing distinction identified by security.
Backend has been asked to address the login timing-enumeration finding under the existing be-3 task. Re-review it once the mitigation is reported.
After the backend mitigation, please rerun the authentication regression suite to confirm no login behavior regressed.

blockers: Security sign-off remains blocked by the documented username-enumeration timing difference in login.
decisions: No duplicate task is created because be-3 already covers login implementation; the mitigation is delegated as a follow-up on that existing work item.
